title: On-VM health check: one e-mail per state change
caption: deploy/scripts/healthcheck.sh (velexis-healthcheck), timer every 5 minutes. State per check in /var/lib/velexis/healthcheck/<check>.state.

actors.label: df, redis-cli INFO, backup marker, openssl s_client

steps.label: ready-<unit> for enabled units (5 s); workers' queues → failed-jobs (> 20/h), queue-age (> 10 min)
disk-root / disk-var-lib-postgresql (> 80 %), redis-memory (> 70 %), backup-age (> 26 h), tls-<host> (< 14 days)
once a UTC day: pay-card.html, pay-airline.html vs payment-page-inventory.json
compare with the last state (ok / fail)
ok→fail: '[velexis][host] health check failed: <check>: <first problem>'; fail→ok: 'health check recovered'
send failed → state kept, run exits 1 → velexis-alert@velexis-healthcheck.service
